FEAT-1-STORY-079.title: Standardize provider search response schema contract
FEAT-1-STORY-079.description: Define and enforce a consistent response schema for provider search results including provider fields, ranking metadata, and location context to ensure stable downstream consumption.

FEAT-1-STORY-080.title: Integrate specialty identification pipeline with provider search
FEAT-1-STORY-080.description: Ensure specialty_service outputs (NUCC codes and expanded queries) are correctly consumed by provider_search_service to drive both vector and taxonomy search paths.

FEAT-1-STORY-081.title: Validate end-to-end provider search via facade
FEAT-1-STORY-081.description: Implement integration tests covering full flow from find_care_facade through specialty extraction, provider search service, and response formatting to ensure orchestration correctness.
